title: Dual Perspectives in Emotion Attribution: A Generator-Interpreter Framework for Cross-Cultural Analysis of Emotion in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating emotion attribution accuracy and systematic misclassification patterns by prompting LLMs with 15 different nationality personas (interpreters) to classify emotional events originating from 15 different countries (generators) using the ISEAR dataset.
Measuring the performance disparities and alignment effects when models interpret emotions using a specific nationality persona versus the actual country of origin of the generated emotional text.
